email.subject: Application received - Product Analyst
email.body:
Hello,

Thanks for applying for the Product Analyst role at Stonebridge Media. Your application has been received.

What happens next: our recruiters review every application within two weeks. If your experience matches the role, we will contact you to arrange interviews with the team. If not, we'll let you know by email.

Thank you for your interest,
Stonebridge Media Careers
